thread:
maria.g: heads up — planning a midday maintenance window for EU/US edge pools tomorrow 12:00-14:00 UTC. Rolling reboots + safety cordon. Low traffic window but we still need to coordinate canaries.
ashok: thanks. which pools exactly? euc1, usw2? what's the expected GPU capacity hit?
lee: euc1 (saturn-pool) + usw2 (meridian). we'll cordon ~20% of capacity in each region at t+0, then drain in 10-min cohorts. overall expected throughput dip ~12-15% for generation workloads.
sre_tier2: any networking changes or just node reboots? last time we saw egress QOS spikes during BMC flips.
maria.g: mostly host reboots and NIC microcode patch. no route or BGP changes. we do expect short-lived egress queue growth while pods reschedule. plan: stagger canaries, monitor p90 latency and egress bytes. if p90 > 500ms for 3m, pause and rollback.
ashok: budget/cost note — if we trigger backfill and spin extra preemptible, could be ~+$2k for the window. can we avoid preemptible bump?
lee: depends on how many tenants are active. we can run the first two cohorts without backfill, risk small queueing. later cohorts we might enable burst backfill with strict max-cost tag.
sre_tier2: add a temporary routing policy to prefer eu-secondary for heavy tenants? that'd reduce cross-region egress but increase latencies for some flows.
maria.g: good call. propose: policy set "prefer-local-with-fallback" but rate-limit cross-region failovers to 20 qps. ops-bot: deploying policy change in 2m — will emit event.
ops-bot: NOTE: policy-change (prefer-local-with-fallback) scheduled at 2025-06-18T11:55:00Z.
lee: canaries: one GPU node in euc1 at 11:50 UTC, then 2 nodes in usw2 at 12:05. health checks: generation latency, kvcache hit rate, and model load times.
nashok: add cost guardrail: if preemptible spend > $500 within 30m, auto-disable backfill and revert to reduced cohort size.
sre_tier2: checklist: alert runbook pinned, observability dashboard linked, oncall mobile ping enabled. who owns rollback? maria?
maria.g: i'll own the rollback decision. lee will execute drains. ashok keeps an eye on cost & scaling.
lee: command snippets for drain:
```
# cordon
kubectl cordon node-0-abc -n inference
# drain with grace
kubectl drain node-0-abc --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 -n inference
```
ashok: will update cost watch script to watch spot spend and post to this thread if threshold exceeded.
ops-bot: REMINDER: maintenance window tomorrow 2025-06-18 12:00-14:00 UTC.
sre_tier2: if we see >5% tail error increase for embeddings within 15m of cohort start, we abort. summarize final schedule and comms and I'll post to #status-mailing.
maria.g: final schedule: 11:50 canary euc1 (1 node), 12:00 cohort A euc1 (10 nodes), 12:05 canary usw2 (2 nodes), 12:20 cohort A usw2 (12 nodes), pausing 15m between cohorts for metrics stabilization. rollback if p90 latency > 500ms or error rate +5% absolute. comms: customer-facing note via incident bot 30m before.
lee: ack. I'll prepare drain scripts and have a quick rollback playbook ready. backups of local caches exported pre-drain.
ashok: ack on cost guards. will disable backfill if spend threshold hits.
maria.g: thanks team — will publish maintenance notice and attach this thread. ping me directly if anything unexpected pops during ops window. :thumbsup:
